init_stdout:
Created Gooo diagnostic starter in workspace
Next: cd workspace && gooo package execute --json --cases cases.json gooo.workspace.json
observation: A self-contained CLI starter produced the source-owned diagnostic tool with a custom module identity. Deterministic ordering took four attempts; the existing own model took two. Both and relocated saved replay matched 8/8 activity outputs. Three additional input rows returned source-owned suggestions with zero new inference and no supplied runtime expectations.
pairing: Same generated source, five construction cases, eight permitted paths, budget eight and runtime cases; ordering differs. The first model proposal matched 3/5 cases and 13/15 fields. Continuation selected a 5/5, 15/15 candidate.
measurement_scope: One deterministic-first sequential pair and saved replays on a shared host with uncontrolled build caches. Prediction/setup timing and resident model tensors have different scope from whole-command time and maximum process RSS. Raw child-process measurements are in each receipt. No comparative speed, causal CPU, general correctness, calibration or external adoption claim.
reproduction: Build cmd/gooo from compiler_revision with Go 1.27.1.
Run gooo init --template diagnostic --module example.org/growth/diagnostic workspace. The six generated files are sufficient for this example.
Run package execute --json --go GO1_27_1 --cases workspace/cases.json workspace/gooo.workspace.json; save deterministic.json.
Repeat with --assembly-model MODEL_JSON from the pinned revision; save model.json and copy it to workspace/execution.json.
Move workspace to moved-workspace, then run package replay --json --go GO1_27_1 --receipt moved-workspace/execution.json --cases moved-workspace/cases.json moved-workspace/gooo.workspace.json.
Repeat saved replay with --inputs moved-workspace/inputs.json in place of --cases. Do not supply model options.
